question: Can a simple target-independent periodicity region finder locate the vowel in isolated single-vowel words?
data: All matched full Hillenbrand recordings and human timedata.dat start/end labels. Reused exploratory corpus, not independent validation.
selection: Longest-energy-weighted sustained periodic region, subject to input gate; no expected vowel or label enters locator
metrics: mean and p95 absolute boundary errors
fraction of predicted interval overlapping annotated vowel
interpretation: 30 ms is a screening threshold, not a pronunciation standard. High midpoint containment does not validate full interval boundaries or general phoneme alignment. /hVd/ words may be easier than ship/sheep.
